mike: quick q — can we shrink notify payloads for console SLO cards? they blow up telemetry and slow the minimap.
mike: current per-alert payload includes full rule, tags, tenant blob, sample window, and route matrix.
rachel: yeah that's been rough for us. the minimap loads ~8 alerts at once and the client chokes on the 150k JSON blobs.
stefan: proposal: a compact protobuf for the notify preview endpoint (binary over wire) + a server-side shim to expand when full details requested.
olivia: i like that. doesn't that change the console <-> api contract though? need a migration plan.
jia: we could add an Accept header `application/x-rw-notify+pb` and keep JSON by default. safe opt-in.
mike: that header approach seems low-risk. also we should gate on `?preview=true` for the minimap queries.
rachel: also want sampling metadata included so the minimap can show noise-estimate badges without full payload.
stefan: sampling meta could be a tiny struct: {sample_rate, noise_score, last_sample_ts}. fits in proto tiny.
olivia: what's the impact on routing policies? some routes need full route-matrix to decide escalate. can we lazy-load that after UI click?
jia: yes — UI requests minimal notify proto first; when user expands an alert, fetch full `/alerts/{id}` JSON.
mike: sounds good. Dev infra question: does the runtime or ingest pipeline produce compact fields already? or we need a transformer in notify-service?
stefan: ingest emits full object. easiest is a transformation layer in notify-service that emits both representations (proto cache + json store reference).
rachel: any telemetry changes? we should keep per-tenant token counts for billing. proto must contain a few token fields (tokens_est, sku_hint) or billing will break.
mike: agreed — proto includes `toks_est` string (small int) and `model_hint` string.
jia: implement proto v1 as additive: field numbers reserved for future. keep backward compat.
olivia: rollout plan: 1) add proto endpoint behind flag, 2) UI opt-in via feature flag, 3) collect error telemetry for 2 weeks, 4) flip default and retire JSON tail-call after 1 month.
stefan: one more: sampling estimator lives in ranking-service now. pls add a compact sample payload in kafka so notify-service can attach it without a join.
mike: ack — add `sampling-summary` topic with small protobuf messages keyed by alert id.
rachel: can we test perf in staging? minimap render time and client memory. set benchmark targets: render <200ms, mem <50MB for 8 alerts.
jia: I'll add a canary header `x-rw-canary: proto-minimap` for traffic shaping.
mike: any changes to SLO threshold UX? compact payload will drop the full expression; we should show a summarized human line.
olivia: summary generation can be server-side: `30m p99 > 2%` style. include `summary_line` in proto.
stefan: code snippet for proto (sketch):
```
message NotifyPreviewV1 {
  string id = 1;
  string tenant_id = 2;
  int32 toks_est = 3;
  string model_hint = 4;
  float noise_score = 5;
  float sample_rate = 6;
  int64 last_sample_ts = 7;
  string summary_line = 8;
}
```

jenkins-bot: deploy-bot triggered notify-service-canary build #1245 — started.

mike: nice, good to see CI. stef, jia — can you pair on the proto+topic changes tomorrow? rachel and olivia will own the UI bits.

rachel: yep, pairing sprints ok. will stub UI to fallback to full JSON when proto missing.
jia: will open RFC PR with suggested header and rollout steps.
stefan: leaving a note: watch for tenant edgecases where route-matrix is > 10kb; lazy-load is crucial.
mike: thanks all. next check-in after RFC PR and a staging perf run. :thumbsup:
